input.label: Case 3: B12 Deficiency After Bariatric Surgery

expected.body: A 54-year-old woman, 2 years after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass, presents with bilateral foot numbness, decreased vibration sense, hemoglobin 9.4 g/dL, MCV 105 fL, and hypersegmented neutrophils. Serum B12 is low; MMA and homocysteine are elevated. Diagnosis: vitamin B12 deficiency from reduced gastric acid and bypass of proximal absorptive sites. Key teaching: elevated MMA confirms B12 (not folate) deficiency; folate alone corrects anemia but allows neuropathy to progress.
